full_name: Calibration-Channel Poisoning of Federated Threshold Personalization in IoT Anomaly Detection
note_raw_data: Raw N-BaIoT datasets are not included. Place inputs under data/raw/N-BaIoT/ to reproduce.
note_outputs_not_committed: The full outputs/ directory is not committed to the repository. Only compact curated artifacts are included in results/.
client_definition: physical IoT devices as FL clients

excluded_scope.CICIoT2023: Not active release scope. Not included in any results/ artifact.
excluded_scope.Edge_IIoTset: Not active release scope. Not included in any results/ artifact.
excluded_scope.journal_extension: Not active release scope. Not included in any results/ artifact.
excluded_scope.stretch_diagnostics: Not primary scope. Not included in results/.
excluded_scope.privacy_guarantees: Not claimed. FL topology is used for realism, not as a privacy mechanism.
excluded_scope.deployment_readiness: Not claimed. This is a controlled empirical study.
excluded_scope.raw_traffic_generation: Out of scope. Attack operates on already-computed anomaly scores.

result_summaries/nbaiot_main/.description: Per-cell per-seed metrics.json for all three threshold policies (30 files: 3 policies × 10 seeds).
result_summaries/nbaiot_main/.content: Per-client FPR, TPR, CV metrics, provenance, schema versions for each policy/seed cell.

configs/nbaiot_main/.description: Resolved experiment configs for all policy/seed cells (30 files).
configs/nbaiot_main/.content: Fully resolved Hydra YAML configs at run time.

split_manifests/nbaiot_main/.description: Per-seed scoring manifests with device split details and model checkpoint hashes (10 files).
split_manifests/nbaiot_main/.content: Expected/actual client IDs, split types, model checkpoint identity, scoring code version.

seeds/nbaiot_main/.description: Per-seed convergence summaries and convergence curves from FL training (20 files).
seeds/nbaiot_main/.content: Convergence round, convergence curve CSV, FL training summary.

figure_inputs/.description: Figure data JSONs and rendered PNG/PDF figures (9 files: 3 data + 3 PNG + 3 PDF).
figure_inputs/.content: figure_1 (per-device FPR), figure_2 (ECDF), figure_3 (boxplots). PNG + PDF + data JSON.

table_inputs/.content: Summary statistics across three threshold policies.

negative_controls/.description: Bootstrap 95% CI results for FPR policy comparisons (2 files: JSON + CSV).
negative_controls/.content: Bootstrap confidence intervals; all policy comparisons exclude zero.

sanity_checks/.description: Schema validation and reporting audit records (2 files).

provenance.json.description: Provenance tying results to code identities, generation timestamps, and current HEAD.
provenance.json.content: Code content-hash identities, generation timestamps, config/split identities, current HEAD.

script_pointers.json.description: Pointers to figure/table generation scripts with expected inputs and outputs.
script_pointers.json.content: Script paths, makefile targets, expected input/output paths for all figures and tables.

CHECKSUMS.sha256.description: SHA-256 checksums for all files under results/ except CHECKSUMS.sha256 itself.

README.txt.description: Human-readable description of results/ contents, scope, and limitations.

outputs/conference_calibration_poisoning.reason: 9.3 MB — too large for Git. Full run manifest with all per-attack per-client records.
outputs/conference_calibration_poisoning.note: Available in the full outputs/ directory on the original research machine. Not required for reproducing figures/tables from per-cell metrics.json.

outputs/scores/nbaiot_main/*/.reason: Raw anomaly score parquet files — many files, each 80KB–3.1 MB. Not required to reproduce figures/tables.

outputs/checkpoints/nbaiot_main/*/model..reason: Binary PyTorch model checkpoints — 112 KB each × 10 seeds. Identities recorded in split_manifests.

split_manifest_with_per_device_calibrati.note: Per-seed scoring_manifest.json (in split_manifests/) contains actual_splits with device-level split metadata. Full calibration-size detail is embedded in per-cell metrics.json provenance.

negative_control_records_per_attack.note: Bootstrap CIs (in negative_controls/) serve as the primary statistical control artifact. Per-attack negative control records are embedded in the full outputs/conference_calibration_poisoning/nbaiot_main_manifest.json which is too large for Git.

isolation_sanity_checks.note: The metrics_schema_validation.json in sanity_checks/ confirms AUROC invariance and schema validation. Full isolation checks are in the reporting_audit.json.
